verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is documented as a coding agent that can query and edit large codebases (gh-1), debug issues in natural language (gh-3), and automate tasks like handling complex rebases (gh-4), which covers part of merge-conflict resolution. It also runs non-interactively for workflow automation (gh-6). None of the four specific chores is explicitly documented, and hands-on users report failed edits, error loops, and files rewritten empty during agentic work (comm-10, comm-11, comm-14), which lowers confidence in how well it does them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of test generation, lint-error fixing, and dependency updates; specific evidence of merge-conflict resolution beyond rebases; independent hands-on confirmation that these tasks work reliably.
